generic.output: France was unable to support the US amendment because it did not see enough clarity and predictability about financing the 25 percent outside assessed contributions.
generic.supplement: The US submitted amendment S/2023/1023. The amendment passed by nine votes to none, with six abstentions, before unanimous adoption of the final resolution. France abstained on the amendment and voted for the amended resolution. The United States sought an explicit ceiling to remove ambiguity and help enable timely deployment. France withheld support for the amendment because it did not clarify how funding outside assessed contributions would be made predictable. France reaffirmed support for assessed UN funding for AU-led operations. The amendment passed despite France's concern about the remainder, distinct from the US demand for an explicit ceiling.
